defective_pattern: Dynamic invariant rules intended to prevent creation of files accidentally blocking deletion/unlinking commands.
why_defective: Causes rule deadlock, preventing decontamination and cleanup of stale validation reports.
observed_symptoms: Failed to delete stale validation reports.
Command execution blocked by invariant rules.
Stale reports persist and cause false validation results.
corrective_remedy: Exempt absolute deletion and unlinking commands (e.g. rm) for stale validation reports from command bans.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Invariant blocks deletion of stale report
